comments.body: @jamorham Perhaps simply synonymous with a time from 0 to 24 clock where you can then adjust when he should go with the screen?

Hi @Aquarius83mn,

there are two ways you can already do something similar:

1) xDrip does have a daydream feature. On a German phone you will find it in the phone settungs under **Display -> Bildschirmschoner**. There you can select xDrip+ as screensaver.

2) If you enable developer mode, you do have the option to keep the screen on when charging. On a German phone you will find this at **Entwickleroptionen -> Aktiv lassen**.

cheers, Adrian

@AdrianLxM I see I have an inactivity screen that would address notifications? But xDrip itself has no adjustable notification which would send on high or low a notification to the display or? Otherwise it would probably be more appropriate. Or do you know an app which you can adjust so that you react to updates of xDrip and then the display turns on?

You are right, always-on screen features are something for a follower phone in this case.
Or the Xperia Z phones you have mentioned, that have a USB port and a separate charger port.

The screen is one of the most battery consuming components. Adding this to a phone that is already hard to charge as the port is needed for the CNL? I don't think an always-on screen would be useful here.

There are some Tasker capabilities that you could try, I'm not sure in what state they are.

Yes, there is a notification that can always show the currend BG and trend on the lock sceen :) You will get it by going to "Settings->Less common settings->Other misc options->Run collector in foreground".

------
Ja, da hast du Recht, Always-On Features sind etwas für das Follower Handy in dem Fall.
Oder die Xperia Z Handies, die du erwähnt hast, die einen USP port und einen separaten Lader haben.

Der Bildschirm eine der energiehungrigsten Komponenten. Das zusammen mit einem Handy, das schon schwer zu laden ist, weil der Ladeanschluss für das CNL benötigt wird? Ich denke nicht, dass da ein Always-On Bildschirm sinnvoll wäre.

Es gibt ein Tasker-Plugin. Ich weiß jedoch nicht in welchem Zustand das gerade ist.

Ja, es gibt eine Notification, die sogar immer anzeigt wie der  aktuelle Wert und trend ist. Auch auf dem Lock-Screen :) Die findest du unter "Settings->Less common settings->Other misc options->Run collector in foreground".

@AdrianLxM Yes, then it becomes difficult, you can times a turn off button in xDrip install? Because if there is no data transfer, the collector always stays on, and beeps every now and then because he gets no value. Got the Collector.

Ja dann wird es schwierig, könnt ihr mal einen Ausschalten Button in xDrip einbauen? Weil wenn es keine Daten überträgt bleibt der Collector immer an, und piepst ab und zu weil er keinen Wert bekommt. Hab den Collector an.

It might work to simply switch to another collection service ("hardware data source") and stop the sensor session in xDrip. Maybe even "stop sensor" is enough.

In order to not having to do that you can go to "Settings->Alarms and Alerts->Missed Reading Alerts" and disable that alert. Then it won't alarm on missed readings.

Hi @Aquarius83mn, xDrip only receives broadcasts form the 600 series uploader but otherwise is unrelated. The repo where you can also open issues is here: https://github.com/pazaan/600SeriesAndroidUploader/issues
It is likely that the 600series uploader has a faillover timer that restarts everything after 20 minutes.

Hi @Aquarius83mn, xDrip empfängtnur Broadcasts vom 600series uploader aber ist sonst unverbunden. Das Repository in dem du auch Issues öffnen kannst findest du hier:  https://github.com/pazaan/600SeriesAndroidUploader/issues
Es ist wahrschienlich, dass der 600series uploader einen Ausfallsicherungs-Timer hat, der ihn wieder nach 20 Minuten startet.
